newsitem.title: USA: U.S. refined copper output rises in December - ABMS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. refined copper output rises in December - ABMS.

text.p: Production of refined copper in the United States rose to 212,000 short tons in December, up from 199,300 short tons in November, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics reported.
Shipments by domestic refiners to U.S. locations in December totaled 198,100 short tons, up from 183,100 short tons in November.
Imports fell to 45,100 short tons in December from 55,800 short tons in November.
The total U.S. shipments in December, including net changes in COMEX and LME stocks in the U.S, was 207,300 short tons, down from 253,900 short tons in November.

Inventory at U.S. refiners at the end of December totaled 16,500 short tons, up 500 tons from November. Inventory at refiners outside the U.S. were 152,000 short tons, up from 149,400 short tons in November.
